description: Issue #388: robots.txt matching. The extension's advisory check (content-script.js evaluateRobotsTxt) and the generated scripts' run-time check (fragments/robots_disallow.py.j2 _parse_robots_rules/_robots_allowed) must agree on RFC 9309 matching: group selection, longest pattern wins, ties go to Allow, * and $. appliesTo ["python"] marks the cases that depend on the script's own ScrapingFactory token, which the advisory check does not know.
